# Injectify

> An Apex framework for Salesforce that gives queries, conditions, triggers, DML and async jobs one consistent model. It is distributed as an unlocked package with the namespace `inj`. Pre-release (0.2.x): the public name and the API may change before 1.0.

Code that uses the framework lives in a subscriber org and reaches it through the namespace: `inj.IQuery`, `inj.Application.make(...)`. Only `global` types are visible there. By convention a subscriber holds its application in a class of its own named `App`, as `App.s`; the guides are written that way.

Things that are easy to get wrong:

- Registry keys are the object's type, not its token: `Account.class => Accounts.class`, never `Account.SObjectType`.
- Query and domain classes extend `inj.BaseQuery` and `inj.BaseDomain`, are declared `global`, and override hooks as `public` or `global` (never `protected`).
- Inside those classes, inherited methods are reached through `base()`: `base().records()`, `base().addCondition(...)`.
- `run()` binds condition values (`:a0`, `:a1`); `toSoql()` writes them inline and is for display.
- Queries and units of work run in system mode unless `withSharing(true)` asks for user mode.
- Framework exceptions other than `inj.Application.FactoryException` and the utility classes' exceptions are not global: catch `Exception`.

## Guides

- [README](README.md): what the framework does, and a sixty-second tour
- [Extension guide](docs/documentation/extension-guide.md): the `App` entry point, custom query classes, domain classes, triggers, services, working across the namespace
- [Query guide](docs/documentation/query-guide.md): fields, lookups and TYPEOF, conditions (built, parsed from text, evaluated in memory), ordering, subqueries, security, aggregate queries, SOSL searches
- [Work guide](docs/documentation/work-guide.md): the unit of work: inserts, updates, upserts, deletes, related records, ordering, user mode, partial success, errors
- [Async guide](docs/documentation/async-guide.md): queueable, batch and schedulable handlers, chaining, jobs started inside jobs, shared values
- [Testing guide](docs/documentation/testing-guide.md): asserting on SOQL, `MockScheme`, testing domains, work and async jobs
- [Utilities guide](docs/documentation/utilities-guide.md): the twelve utility classes (test data, CSV, fields, records, persistent values, limits, UUIDs)
